events.title: Burn the Witch or Set Her Free? Your First Moral Choice
events.summary: Moral choices and branching paths have always been my favorite things in games. A shout-out to all The Succession of Changing Kings fans! I especially appreciate it when decisions truly affect what happens, rather than creating a carefully scripted illusion of choice.In Your Judgment, Inquisitor, you’ll make one of the key decisions during the tutorial. events.summary: Another month has passed, and as usual, I’m sharing some new artwork and answering a few of your questions.Will it be possible to play as a good inquisitor? I hope you’ve heard of the Black Legend.Yes, you’ll have a great deal of freedom, and you can complete the entire game without sending a single person to the stake. events.title: A rabbi, a monk, and a bard walk into a cider house...

events.title: About the locations in the game
events.summary: Danger awaits the inquisitor at every step. If you start condemning every parishioner to an auto-da-fé without discrimination, the pious Christians might hang you right on the gates of the cathedral. And if you show excessive piety, you may find yourself facing a church tribunal. May God protect you from the wrath of Torquemada.However, today I will show you a number of places that are no less dangerous. events.title: Greek Language, a Demon, and Q&A
events.summary: Your Judgment, Inquisitor is approaching the coveted milestone of 10000 wishlists, an incredible result for a two-person team, a Russian and a Ukrainian. And there are still 10 months to go before release!Unexpectedly for us, a noticeable share of wishlists is coming from Greece (650+). Naturally, we couldn’t ignore that, the game will definitely be released in Greek as well.\A fun but useless fact: one of the developers’ mother speaks Greek at about a B2 level. events.title: 2 rooms, a demon, and an artist
events.summary: As part of your inquisitorial service, you will also have to deal with exorcism. Each turn, the player chooses one of three locations. A demon may be hiding in each of them — or there may be none at all. You will have to determine this by collecting clues inside the location and by carefully listening to what is said in the monastery and during confession. events.summary: The game has crossed the 6,000 wishlists mark.
